text:
Which statement about a voltmeter is correct?
A
A voltmeter measures the current in a component and is connected in series with the
component.
B
A voltmeter measures the current in a component and is connected in parallel with the
component.
C
A voltmeter measures the potential difference (p.d.) across a component and is connected in
series with the component.
D
A voltmeter measures the potential difference (p.d.) across a component and is connected in
parallel with the component.
